welcome_description: Load a Gravis Ultrasound .PAT file or a SoundFont .SF2 file (automatically converted into multiple GUS patches). Edit patch properties, edit waveforms, import/export WAV files, and test sounds using your keyboard or MIDI. All data is stored in your browser's IndexedDB. Warning: SoundFont files are generally large, and their size can grow substantially when converted to GUS Patches. Make sure your computer has at least 16 GB of RAM and 15 GB of free storage.
